messages:
mira_sales: Hey team — Argentum Financials just sent back the RFP and asked for: capability matrix, completed security questionnaire, and a POC pricing estimate. They want a POC next month; target ask is EOD Thu for materials to hand to their procurement. @jamal_se @lee_security @anita_prod can you triage?

jamal_se: Quick Qs — is the POC embeddings-only or full chat/generation? also need expected QPS and whether they require on-prem private deployment or hosted with VPC peering.

mira_sales: Conversation so far: they want chat assistant + semantic search (embeddings). Target peak ~80 qps during load tests, offline data size ~200GB (documents). They're open to hosted but will ask about private deployment for prod. For POC they're ok with hosted if we provide data residency controls.

anita_prod: For capability matrix: recommend we include two rows for model variants: Redwood-3B-quant (cost-left) and Redwood-7B-pt (latency/quality). Call out: streaming support, tool-calls, embeddings vector dim, max context, KV cache behavior, quantization compatibility, and recommended batch settings. I can draft CSV with columns today.

sam_infra: For 80 qps sustained with low tail latency we'll need either Dedicated pool or Reserved hosted nodes with burst. Ballpark POC cost (hosted): $12k/week if we keep concurrency and run load tests; Dedicated baseline monthly commit for that shape starts ~$18k/mo; can do a short 2-week eval at reduced rate if we commit to follow-up. Also flag: HSM-backed KMS for key separation adds ops work — see security notes.

lee_security: Security questionnaire highlights I pulled from their doc: they ask about SOC2, penetration testing cadence, HSM/KMS options, VPC peering, dedicated audit logs retention (1yr vs 7yrs), and data-at-rest encryption with customer-controlled keys. We support SOC2 and provide attestations. HSM: we offer KMS integrations but on-prem HSM for Private deployments is a commercial add-on. Pentest: we can provide recent report and schedule retest; third-party vendor takes 3 weeks lead time. I'll attach a redlined answers doc.

mira_sales: Can someone drop links to the draft capability matrix and the redlined questionnaire here? I'll zip attachments and upload to the RFP portal. Also need a concise POC pricing table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and a suggested SOW bullets.

deploy-bot: Uploaded file: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/capability-matrix-draft.csv (view)

anita_prod: Link to matrix received. Notes: add a "fallback policy" column (canary->A/B->fallback smaller model) and an "expected token cost / 1k conv turns" estimate for each model. I'll add sample prompts and perf expectations for the doc.

jamal_se: For the questionnaire I'll need to know whether they expect HSM on day-1 for the POC. If yes, POC moves to Private or Dedicated with KMS integration — increases timeline. If no, we can use hosted KMS and provide segregation via project keys.

lee_security: Confirming: HSM required for production only; POC can proceed with customer-managed KMS (cloud) if they agree. I'm drafting the Q&A: examples: "Do you support bringing-your-own-key?" -> "yes, via customer-managed KMS with audit logs; HSM option available for Private deployments."

sam_infra: POC checklist item: VPC peering test, sample dataset upload process (S3 presigned or direct transfer), and load test harness. Jamal — can you share the local runbook snippet?

jamal_se: Putting a short runbook here: ```1) create project with dataset ACLs
2) upload 200GB to staging S3
3) enable prefix caching = on
4) route QA traffic via canary model ratio 10%
5) run ramp test to 80 qps for 30m
6) collect latency percentiles and KV cache hit rate```

mira_sales: Great. I updated the procurement ask to request a 30-day evaluation with optional extension. I'm going to push the capability matrix and redlined security answers by EOD Thu. Sam, can you give me a short hosted vs dedicated pricing blurb to paste into the RFP?

sam_infra: Hosted (no commit): $12k/week estimate for the POC load profile. Dedicated (1-month reserve): $18k/mo baseline for same throughput + optional SLA. Private/on-prem: custom quote; add integration & HSM fees ~$25k one-time. We can offer a 10% commercial discount for 3-6 month pilots.

lee_security: I'll attach the redline: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/security-qna-redline.docx and a SOC2 summary. Also need a rubric for sensitive data handling during POC — I'll paste separately.

anita_prod: Uploaded capability matrix CSV v2: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/capability-matrix-v2.csv — added fallback and token-cost columns.

mira_sales: Perfect. Action items: jamal -> finalize runbook + test scripts; anita -> finalize CSV + 1-page feature summary; lee -> finalize redlined questionnaire + SOC2 attestation; sam -> short pricing blurb and POC cost table. I'll assemble and upload to the RFP portal Thu EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jamal_se: Will do, aiming to push scripts by tomorrow noon.

lee_security: I'll finish redline and pentest timeline by Wed.

sam_infra: Sending pricing blurb in DM to Mira now.

mira_sales: Thanks team, will ping if procurement asks for legal T&Cs.
